chunks.title: Return & Refund Policy
chunks.text: Customers may raise a return within 7 days of delivery for unused, unwashed items with original tags intact. Damaged, defective or wrong items must be reported within 48 hours of delivery with unboxing photos or a video; these qualify for a full refund including shipping. Approved refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5 to 7 working days, or to store credit within 24 hours if the customer prefers.

Made-to-order, personalised and innerwear items are non-returnable unless they arrive damaged. Reverse pickup is free on serviceable pin codes. Where pickup is unavailable, customers may self-ship and upload the courier receipt for reimbursement up to ₹150. Refunds for cash-on-delivery orders are paid to the customer's UPI ID or bank account after manual verification.

chunks.title: Shipping Timelines
chunks.text: Metro pin codes are delivered in 2 to 4 working days, tier-2 cities in 3 to 6 working days, and North-East, Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal and island pin codes in 7 to 10 working days. Orders placed before 2 PM IST are dispatched the same working day. Orders placed on Sunday or a national holiday are dispatched on the next working day. Tracking links activate within 24 hours of dispatch and sometimes take up to 6 hours to refresh after a scan.

Delayed shipments that run more than 48 hours past the promised date are eligible for a ₹100 shipping credit on request. We currently ship within India only; international shipping is not available. Delivery to Port Blair and other island pin codes depends on courier serviceability and can take up to 10 working days.

chunks.title: Warranty Terms
chunks.text: Household and kitchen products carry a 6-month manufacturing warranty from the date of delivery, covering seams, joints, handles and structural defects. Brass and copper items naturally develop a patina over time; that is not a defect and is not covered. Silver-plated and oxidised jewellery has a 30-day plating warranty, after which re-polishing is chargeable at ₹199. Warranty claims need the order ID and a photo or short video of the issue. Replacements ship within 3 working days of approval.

Accidental damage, misuse, dishwasher use on handwash-only items and normal wear are excluded. The warranty is non-transferable and applies only to the original purchaser with a valid order record.

chunks.title: UPI & Payment Failures
chunks.text: If money was debited but the order was not confirmed, the amount is auto-reversed by the bank or UPI PSP within 48 hours. Customers should not retry the payment immediately. Share the 12-digit UPI reference number or a screenshot so support can reconcile it with the payment gateway ledger. Failed payments never create a duplicate order. Cash on delivery is unavailable on orders above ₹5,000 or on pin codes marked prepaid-only.
